eyebrow: SQL Server HA, Backup & Disaster Recovery · Chapter Six
subtitle: Lesson 29 · Log Shipping & Database Mirroring

steps.label: Backup job (primary)
steps.sub: log backup every 5–15 min to a shared folder

steps.label: Copy job (secondary)
steps.sub: copies new backup files to a local folder

steps.label: Restore job (secondary)
steps.sub: restores each log backup in sequence

code:
RESTORE LOG [db] FROM DISK = '...'
  WITH NORECOVERY
  -- inaccessible, ready for the next restore

RESTORE LOG [db] FROM DISK = '...'
  WITH STANDBY = 'undo_file_path'
  -- read-only and queryable between restores
caption: NORECOVERY for pure failover targets; STANDBY for a queryable copy.
